text:
jordan: quick sync — we should run a stability sweep for speculative decoding warmup behavior across quantized candidates. seeing flakiness in p95 latency and small quality regressions when KV cache is hot vs cold. anyone free to weigh in?

maria: +1, saw the same on yesterday's canary. p50 okay but p95 spikes when cache eviction happens.

sam: do we have a reproducible harness? need deterministic seeds + fixed prefix lengths. otherwise noise dominates.

jordan: proposed plan: 1) fixed eval set of 2k multi-turn prompts (user_sim_v2), 2) run each model variant (fp16, int8-quant, int4-lite) with cache states: cold (no KV), warm (recent prefixes), stale (mismatched KV from different session). 3) collect latency p50/p95/p99, token throughput, and quality deltas (ROUGE-L + self-BLEU + log-perp). 4) 10 random seeds for sampling variants.

leah: add acceptance metrics: answer-coherence score from our auto-eval + small human spot-check (50 examples). also track hallucination proxy: contradiction-rate.

maria: important: measure speculative abort rate and wasted tokens. speculative decoding often issues extra speculative tokens that get discarded — that cost needs to be in the unit-economics table.

sam: agree. Also let's measure "prefetch hit ratio" and "kv-lookup latency". Ops-bot can emit pprof traces around the speculative path? @ops-bot can you attach? :pray:

ops-bot: attaching recent pprof sample for speculative path. snippet: ```# pprof summary
samples: 1200
cpu: 2.6s
functions: speculative_prefetch: 42%, kv_lookup: 18%, token_emit: 10%```

jordan: thanks. experiment matrix draft: (3 quant levels) x (3 cache states) x (2 batch sizes: 1,8) x (2 sampling modes: top-p(0.9), top-k(50)). ~36 runs x 10 seeds = 360 total. estimate ~12 hours on a 8-GPU dedicated pool.

leah: we should prune: maybe skip int4-lite on batch=8 until we rule out basic regressions — int4 sometimes noisier. keep it in backlog.

maria: also add model-variant fallback test: when speculative path fails, does runtime fall back to non-speculative in <200ms? record fallback count.

jordan: good call. I'll sketch the harness commands and a minimal config. example run: ```sh
redwood run --model llama3-12b-quant --mode speculative --seed 42 --cache-state warm --batch 1 --sampling top-p=0.9 --out results/warm_p0.9_seed42.json
```

sam: for quality diffs: compute pairwise edit-distance between baseline fp16 greedy output and each speculative run; and report %cases where token-level divergence occurs within first 32 tokens. that captures prefix sensitivity.

leah: and add regression alert thresholds: if ROUGE-L drops >1.5 or hallucination proxy increases >2% we block the variant.

jordan: timeline: start runs tonight on staging, collate tomorrow morning. can one of you own the dashboard ingest? need per-run CSV with columns: run_id, model, quant, cache_state, batch, sampling, seed, p50,p95,p99,throughput,spec_aborts,kv_hit_ratio,rouge,bleu,edit_divergence,halluc_proxy,fallbacks

maria: I can own ingest + dashboard. will reuse the spec-eval template and add cost columns.

sam: I'll wire the harness + CI job to kick off the grid and upload artifacts to storage.

leah: I'll prepare the 50 human checks and the automatic eval scripts.

jordan: perf note — if prefetch hit ratio < 70% on warm runs we should suspect sharding/placement mismatch not the algo. call it out in the run notes.

maria: noted. also tagging customer-impacting flows (chat streams) so ops can prioritize.

sam: one more: capture seed-specific variance table so we can show if noise explains small quality gaps.

jordan: perfect. thanks team — will post the matrix + run IDs when started. :rocket:
